proves.claim: for a global, an npx and a project install, pullboard update run as the real CLI runs that kind's upgrade through a stub npm and prints the changelog sections between the two versions.

cli.journeys-version-update.each-install.why: Without it update could pick the wrong upgrade for an install kind and no journey would notice.

proves.claim: pullboard update says Pullboard is already current when the stub reports the running version, and refuses UPDATE_KIND_UNKNOWN naming the one manual command for an install it cannot tell.

cli.journeys-version-update.current-and-.why: Without it an up-to-date or unclassifiable install could run an upgrade or fail without guidance.
